pages.lesson:
LESSON: OBLIGATIONS OF PARENTS TO CHILDREN

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Muamalaat (Social Relations)
Topic 6.1: Obligations of Parents to Children

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Obligations of Parents to Children
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What are some of the things parents do for their children?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. state the obligations of parents to their children
2. demonstrate ways in which parents can fulfil their obligations to their children

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: state the obligations of parents to their children

Teach
• Today’s focus: state the obligations of parents to their children.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “state the obligations of parents to their children” using a school example.
• Model B for “state the obligations of parents to their children” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "state the obligations of parents to their children" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: demonstrate ways in which parents can fulfil their obligations to their children

Teach
• Today’s focus: demonstrate ways in which parents can fulfil their obligations to their children.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “demonstrate ways in which parents can fulfil their obligations to their children” using a school example.
• Model B for “demonstrate ways in which parents can fulfil their obligations to their children” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "demonstrate ways in which parents can fulfil their obligations to their children" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: state the obligations of parents to their children
• Model 2: demonstrate ways in which parents can fulfil their obligations to their children

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: state the obligations of parents to their children
2. Practise: demonstrate ways in which parents can fulfil their obligations to their children

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Obligations of Parents to Children.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What are some of the things parents do for their children?
2. Why is it important for parents to fulfil their obligation towards their children?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• state the obligations of parents to their children
• demonstrate ways in which parents can fulfil their obligations to their children

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
